description: A utility module for generating HTML diffs between two multi-line strings, primarily used for visualizing differences between text files in a web-friendly format.

classes.name: HtmlDiffGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating HTML table rows that highlight differences between two text sequences.

methods.name: html_diff
methods.description: Main function that returns an HTML diff between two strings.

methods.name: HtmlDiffGenerator.__init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing line counters for diff generation.

methods.name: HtmlDiffGenerator.generate_tbody
methods.description: Generates the HTML table body with diff-highlighted lines.

methods.name: _format_chunk
methods.description: Formats a diff chunk based on its type (insert, delete, replace, equal).

methods.name: _format_equal
methods.description: Formats unchanged lines, with context trimming for large chunks.

methods.name: _format_equal_line
methods.description: Formats a single line of unchanged text with line numbers.
